data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘m-a-‘ meaning ‘mother’. In Islamic spirituality, Ma represents the nurturing and protective nature of Allah towards His believers. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ma usually hope their child will grow to embody mother and live with faith, good character and purpose.
